title: Understanding the Dataset
text: The dataset contains information about what students ate for lunch, including the foods, servings, and total calories. Each row represents a single lunch entry for a student.

title: Bootstrap Sampling
text: Bootstrap sampling involves repeatedly sampling with replacement from the dataset to create 'bootstrap samples'. These samples are used to estimate the distribution of a statistic.

title: Percentile Calculation
text: To find the lower percentile, you need to calculate the $$2.5th$$ percentile of the bootstrap estimates. This is often used to determine the lower bound of a confidence interval.
